latin: Cum Platonem audimus Palladem et amorem philosophos deos uocantem, ita intelligamus, ut amor sit philosophus ratione uiae, Pallas ratione termini.
translation: Plato speaks of Pallas and Love as philosopher-gods; take this to mean that Love earns the name philosopher through the road travelled, and Pallas through the destination reached.
